issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted 2026-08-12) decided to introduce a third dependency kind, `verifies`, and diagnose inverted verification gates structurally from that declaration, but no open bead tracks the implementation. Implement it: extend the dependency model, store rows, checkpoint schema, events, and CLI so an author can declare a `verifies` edge; add an advisory diagnosis that reports a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead (doctor scope or a dedicated report), never rejecting the edge at insert time and never inferring the relationship from issue titles; keep the §3.4 cycle rejection and two-kind 0.1 behavior otherwise unchanged. Cover the new edge kind with concurrency tests, checkpoint round-trip and unknown-field preservation, and update the field guide (`bead schema explain`), help text, and the NEEDLE compatibility contract (`research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md`).

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
